chapter_seo_title: Dao Guai Yi Xian Ch. 410: The Truth of Da Qi - A Flaming Brawl and Shattering Revelation
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang fights burning Zuowandao, then gets a lore bomb: Da Qi is real, and Zhuge Yuan just sent his enemies there. The hunt for Northern Wind ends before it begins.
og_title: Chapter 410: The Truth of Da Qi - The Hunt is Over
og_description: Li Huowang carves his way through Zuowandao and discovers reality is a lot more flexible than he thought.
twitter_title: Ch. 410: The world-shattering truth about Da Qi revealed!
twitter_description: Li Huowang's desperate battle leads to a revelation that rewrites everything about the world he knows.

lore_anchors.definition: A long, two-handed heavy blade historically used by Chinese infantry. In the novel, it is depicted as a massive, brutal weapon favored by strong fighters.
The corrupted counterpart to the Heart-Element. Its ability is to "hide" or erase concepts, objects, and memories from reality, rather than making fictions real.
The primary target of Li Huowang's current mission. A high-value enemy whose location and strength were previously unknown.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the power of the Heart-Turbid?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Heart-Turbid can hide or erase the truth from reality, making people forget things as if they never existed. Zhuge Yuan used it to make the Zuowandao forget Da Liang.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is Da Qi real or is it an illusion?
cultural_notes_faq.a: This is the central philosophical conflict. Zhuge Yuan insists Da Qi is real and Da Liang is the fake one. The ability to "send" people there suggests it has a tangible reality, accessible by conceptual erasure.
He is the primary target of Li Huowang's mission, a key member of the Zuowandao. He is revealed at the end of the chapter, having been captured by Zhuge Yuan.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the relationship between Heart-Element and Heart-Turbid?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Heart-Element makes false things true. The Heart-Turbid makes true things false or forgotten. They are opposing forces in the novel's system of reality manipulation.
